title: Robot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='36' ry='7' fill='#2a3d5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='87' rx='22' ry='4' fill='#3d5a85'/>
  <!-- left leg (kicking up) -->
  <rect x='24' y='68' width='10' height='18' rx='4' fill='#3d8fd6' transform='rotate(-22 29 77)'/>
  <rect x='20' y='78' width='13' height='7' rx='3' fill='#9be6ff' transform='rotate(-22 26.5 81.5)'/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <rect x='58' y='64' width='10' height='20' rx='4' fill='#3d8fd6' transform='rotate(12 63 74)'/>
  <rect x='62' y='80' width='13' height='7' rx='3' fill='#9be6ff' transform='rotate(12 68.5 83.5)'/>
  <!-- left arm up -->
  <rect x='12' y='34' width='9' height='22' rx='4' fill='#3d8fd6' transform='rotate(38 16.5 45)'/>
  <circle cx='11' cy='33' r='5' fill='#9be6ff'/>
  <!-- right arm out -->
  <rect x='76' y='44' width='9' height='22' rx='4' fill='#3d8fd6' transform='rotate(-52 80.5 55)'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='42' r='5' fill='#9be6ff'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <rect x='30' y='50' width='38' height='26' rx='9' fill='#4fb3e8'/>
  <rect x='36' y='56' width='26' height='14' rx='6' fill='#2b7fb8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <rect x='28' y='20' width='42' height='32' rx='9' fill='#5fc4f2'/>
  <!-- face screen -->
  <rect x='33' y='25' width='32' height='22' rx='6' fill='#1a2c45'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='34' r='3' fill='#7bffd0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='34' r='3' fill='#7bffd0'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 41 Q49 46 56 41' stroke='#7bffd0' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='49' y1='20' x2='49' y2='12' stroke='#9be6ff' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='9' r='4' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='20' r='3' fill='#ff8fc7'/>
  <rect x='87.5' y='10' width='2' height='10' fill='#ff8fc7'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='22' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='15.5' y='12' width='2' height='10' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
